name: Porima PLA, Şahin 2026 FDM AC breakdown discs

names.en: Porima PLA, Şahin 2026 FDM AC breakdown discs
names.zh: Porima PLA，Şahin 2026 FDM 交流击穿圆片
names.ja: Porima PLA、Şahin 2026 FDM 交流絶縁破壊円板
names.de: Porima PLA, Şahin 2026 FDM-Scheiben für Wechselspannungsdurchschlag

product_form.text: FDM-printed electrical-test disc, nominal diameter 50 mm and nominal thickness 1.2 mm; from 1.75 mm Porima filament
product_form.notes: Nominal geometry, not individually measured specimen thicknesses; separate from Type I tensile specimens.

processing.text: Qidi Q1 Pro FDM; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.2 mm layer height; nominal 100% rectilinear infill; nozzle 220 °C; bed 60 °C; chamber not reported; printing ambient 23 °C; filament pre-dried 50 °C for 6 h

evidence.locator: PDF pp5–6, §2.2 and Tables2–3, PLA column

processing.notes: Filament drying is a processing step, not post-print specimen conditioning; printing ambient is not electrical-test temperature. Nominal infill is not measured zero porosity.

conditioning.notes: Post-print humidity, conditioning interval and pre-test equilibration unknown; pre-print filament drying recorded under processing.

composition_or_purity.notes: Family label only; numerical purity, additives, fillers and PC/ABS blend fractions are not supplied.

reinforcement.notes: No reinforcement or filler composition is established for the study product; unfilled is not inferred.

porosity.notes: 100% slicer infill does not establish zero specimen porosity.

orientation.notes: Raster/build orientation and its relation to the electrical field unknown; rectilinear infill does not establish them.

source_scope: Single-study electrical-disc group under the existing polymer identity. No new grade, identity or independent physical-coverage claim. Nominal infill does not establish full density; actual individual thickness, batch count, composition, additives, conditioning and field/build relation unknown. Not a tensile-specimen state or universal polymer property.
